featured.title: ResearchMind — Multi-Agent AI Research System
featured.body: Give it a topic and four agents collaborate to produce a sourced research report. A Search agent queries Tavily, a Reader agent scrapes the most relevant page, a Writer chain drafts the report, and a Critic chain reviews and scores it out of 10. Citations are collected from raw tool output rather than the model's summary, so the sources are real — and prompt budgets are trimmed to fit Groq's free-tier token limit.

featured.title: AI Video Assistant
featured.body: Turns any YouTube video or audio file into a transcript, a structured summary, action items, decisions, and open questions — plus a chatbot you can question about its contents. Audio is chunked with yt-dlp/ffmpeg, transcribed through three switchable engines (Deepgram, Sarvam, and local Whisper), summarised map-reduce style with Mistral so long recordings never blow the context window, and indexed into ChromaDB for retrieval-augmented Q&A. Every run is persisted, so reopening a video is instant.

featured.title: Resume Analyzer — AI-Powered Resume Screening
featured.body: A full-stack NLP web app that parses resumes (PDF/DOCX) and extracts skills and named entities with spaCy PhraseMatcher and NER, served through a documented FastAPI REST API and a Streamlit UI. Semantic job-description matching uses sentence-transformer embeddings and cosine similarity to score resume–JD fit (0–100) and surface missing skills — capturing meaning rather than keyword overlap.

featured.title: Pneumonia Detection from Chest X-rays
featured.body: A transfer-learning pipeline for binary classification of chest X-ray images. Benchmarked DenseNet121, ResNet18, and MobileNetV2 across TensorFlow/Keras and PyTorch, fine-tuning ImageNet-pretrained backbones in two phases with custom image preprocessing. Evaluated on accuracy, ROC-AUC, precision, recall, and F1 to pick the best architecture — reaching 90.87% accuracy.

featured.title: TOPSIS — Python Package for Multi-Criteria Decision Making
featured.body: A reusable, distribution-ready Python package implementing the TOPSIS algorithm, structured to standard PyPI packaging conventions. Ships a CLI for CSV/XLSX datasets with automated validation of weights and impacts, plus weighted normalization, ideal-solution computation, and ranking logic for multi-criteria decision analysis.

archive.title: Model Selection for Sentence Similarity
archive.body: Benchmarked five pretrained encoders on the STS Benchmark across Pearson correlation, inference time, and model size, then ranked them with TOPSIS — all-MiniLM-L6-v2 won at 0.999.

archive.title: GAN for MNIST Digit Generation
archive.body: A generator/discriminator pair trained adversarially in PyTorch over 20 epochs — BCE loss, Adam, a 100-dim latent space — producing increasingly digit-like handwritten samples.

archive.title: Fraud Detection under Class Imbalance
archive.body: Five sampling strategies (SMOTE, NearMiss, SMOTE+Tomek, over/under-sampling) crossed with five classifiers on a 1.15%-fraud dataset — applied to training folds only, and scored on recall and ROC-AUC rather than misleading accuracy.

archive.title: Mashup Generator
archive.body: Downloads N tracks by an artist from YouTube, converts and trims each to a fixed clip, and merges them into one mashup — shipped as both a CLI and a Flask web app that emails the result as a ZIP.

archive.title: Simulation-Driven Data Generation
archive.body: Generated 1,000 methane–air combustion runs with the Cantera simulator, then trained eight regressors to predict adiabatic flame temperature — Random Forest led with R² = 0.995.

experience.title: ELC Summer Internship
experience.org: Thapar Institute of Engineering and Technology
points: Built an ML/DL pipeline to classify ADHD vs. healthy subjects from 19-channel EEG (121 subjects, 2.16M records), covering preprocessing, a stratified train–test split, and leakage-free feature scaling.
Benchmarked Logistic Regression, Random Forest, and a hybrid LSTM+CNN model combining spatial and temporal EEG feature extraction.
Best results came from the LSTM+CNN model — 76.9% accuracy, 0.84 ROC-AUC, 0.85 ADHD recall — outperforming the baseline classifiers on non-linear EEG patterns.
